blocks.title: GridCraft in the activity panel
blocks.description: Cells, formulas, charts and pivot tables — the upstream GridCraft spreadsheet running inside Astravia, on the workbook you opened in the workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: Sum the revenue column by month in this sheet.
showcase.assistant_reply: GridCraft is open with the workbook. Select the header row and I will walk the cells with you — say whether you want a pivot table or a SUMIFS column.

items.title: A real calculation engine
items.description: Formulas, references, number formats and error values behave the way a spreadsheet should, so a figure computed here still holds when the file goes back out.

items.title: .xlsx in and out
items.description: Workbooks open from the workspace and export back to it, so the file keeps working in whatever tool the other people use.

items.title: Charts and pivot tables
items.description: Summary views are built from the same cells the sheets contain — the picture and the numbers cannot disagree.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: About 10 MB of editor files arrive on first open and are reused offline after that.

items.title: Open the GridCraft tab
items.description: The preparation screen is the hub fetching its payload.

items.title: Select a workbook, then open it
items.description: File → Open inside the editor takes the file selected in Astravia.

items.title: Export the result back
items.description: Exports travel the same bridge as saves.

blocks.content: GridCraft does not cover every Excel function, and macros do not run. The plugin runs the pinned release — check a formula's result in the sheet before quoting it.
